presets.name: Just a metronome
presets.description: One click a beat and nothing else, with four beats of the picture down the pane.
presets.tryThis: Change the tempo, and play along to see where your notes land.

presets.name: 16ths against the grid
presets.description: One row per 16th note, so the notes you are aiming at are a straight line down the pane. Green is the note, red is as far off it as you can get. The rows, the margins and both grids are written in terms of the parameters bar and n.
presets.tryThis: Set the parameter n to 12: every row becomes a triplet 8th and the whole pane follows it.

presets.name: Basic backbeat
presets.description: A backbeat from the built-in kit at 99: accented sixteenths on the hi-hat, snare on 2 and 4, kick on 1 with the odd pickup into the next bar. One row per sixteenth, so each note you aim at is a straight line down the pane.
presets.tryThis: Play the snare part along with it and watch whether your 2 and 4 land on the line.

presets.name: Basic swing
presets.description: A jazz ride pattern at 240 -- spang, spang-a-lang -- with the hi-hat on 2 and 4, one row per swung eighth. The parameter swing is the long note's share of each pair: 0.5 is straight, 0.67 is triplet swing. beats sets how many pairs each pane holds.
presets.tryThis: Set swing to 0.67 for triplet swing, or 0.5 to straighten it out -- the ride, the hi-hat and the rows all follow it.

presets.name: Count-off, then groove
presets.description: The practice cycle: a bar of click to count you in, then four bars of backbeat, round and round. The count-off isn't drawn, so the groove starts at the top of the pane.
presets.tryThis: In Play, change the practice cycle's order to 1, 2, 3 to add four bars of just the click after the groove -- does your time hold without the drums?

views.name: the groove, one bar per row

presets.name: Loop yourself
presets.description: The looper records everything you play and plays it back two bars later, once. The pane is two bars long, so the echo is drawn right where you played it. Use headphones: on speakers the looper hears itself.
presets.tryThis: Play a one-bar phrase and stop: it comes back two bars later. Then play over it, or set Echoes to 3 to hear it three times.

presets.name: Backbeat on/off
presets.description: The practice cycle as call and response: the backbeat and click for a turn, then the same length of silence. The parameter cycle sets how many beats each turn lasts. With the looper on, what you played during the groove comes back in the silence. Use headphones.
presets.tryThis: Switch on Looper in the top bar, play along with the backbeat, then listen to yourself in the silence.

presets.name: 3 against 4
presets.description: Two panes over the same two bars: the left ruled in 4, one row per beat, the right in 3, one row per third of a bar. The click plays the 4 and the snare the 3; each pane draws the other ruling faintly, so you can see where the two meet.
presets.tryThis: Play the snare's three: your notes sit on the lines in the right-hand pane and walk across the rows in the left.
